app.name: KatWork
auth.panel.title: Your team of Dots is ready when you are.
auth.panel.dots: Dots are AI assistants that research, draft and check your documents.
auth.panel.trust: AI drafts and does a first check — you review and approve.
nav.sign_out_failed: Sign-out didn't finish, so you're still signed in.
login.title: Sign in
login.lede: Use the email and password your admin set up for you.
reset.request.title: Reset your password
reset.request.lede: Enter the email you sign in with. If it has an account, we'll send a link to choose a new password.
reset.request.sent: Check your inbox. If an account uses that email, a reset link is on its way. The link works once and expires in 30 minutes.
reset.confirm.title: Choose a new password
reset.confirm.lede: After the change you'll be signed out on every device. Then sign in with the new password.
reset.confirm.mismatch: The two passwords don't match. Type the same password in both fields.
reset.confirm.done: Password saved. Sign in with your new password.
home.title: Your team office
home.lede: Your Dots will gather here. Soon you'll meet your team and chat with them.
home.team.title: Team
home.team.empty: Your team of Dots shows up here: a Lead, plus AI assistants who research, write, analyse, schedule and review.
home.chat.title: Chat
home.chat.empty: Talk to one Dot or the whole team here.
chat.empty: No messages yet. Say hello to your team to get started.
chat.composer_hint: Enter sends. Shift+Enter adds a new line.
chat.synthetic_hint: A sample reply from demo mode, not from an AI model.
reason.provider_unavailable: The AI model service isn't responding right now. Try again in a few minutes.
reason.provider_rate_limited: The AI model service is busy. Try again in a minute.
reason.provider_quota: This workspace has used up its AI model allowance. Ask your admin to check the plan or budget.
reason.provider_auth_failed: The AI model service rejected KatWork's key. Ask your admin to check the model settings.
reason.model_protocol_error: The AI model sent a reply KatWork couldn't read. Try again.
reason.time_limit: The Dot ran out of time before finishing. Try a smaller request.
reason.quota_exceeded: This workspace has reached its usage limit for today. Try again tomorrow or ask your admin.
reason.workspace_paused: Your admin has paused the Dots in this workspace. The work waits until they're resumed.
reason.step_limit: The Dot took too many steps without finishing. Try splitting the request into smaller parts.
reason.token_budget: The Dot used up its budget for this request. Try a shorter request.
reason.output_truncated: The reply was too long and got cut off. Ask for a shorter answer.
reason.residency_denied: This Space keeps its data on this server, and no local AI model is set up. Ask your admin to add one.
reason.loop_detected: The Dot kept repeating the same step, so KatWork stopped it. Rephrase the request and try again.
reason.policy_changed: The Dot's settings changed while it was working, so it stopped. Send the request again.
reason.approval_pending: A Dot is waiting for your approval before it continues.
reason.question_pending: A Dot asked you a question. Answer it to continue.
reason.interrupted_review_required: The work stopped partway after it had started changing things. Review what happened before trying again.
reason.dot_paused: That Dot is paused. Ask your admin to resume it, or ask another Dot.
reason.retries_exhausted: KatWork tried several times and couldn't finish. Try again later.
reason.outcome_unknown: A Dot started an action, but KatWork couldn't confirm whether it finished. Check the result before trying again.
reason.no_eligible_dot: No Dot in this team can take that request here. Check the team, or mention a Dot by name.
reason.dot_not_in_space: That Dot doesn't work in this Space. Ask your admin to add it.
reason.lease_lost: The Dot's work was interrupted. KatWork is picking it up again.
reason.unauthenticated: That email and password don't match. Check them and try again.
reason.reset_token_invalid: This reset link no longer works. Links work once and expire after 30 minutes. Request a new one.
reason.password_invalid: Choose a password with at least 8 characters.
reason.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
reason.request_invalid: Something in the form isn't right. Check it and try again.
reason.body_too_large: That's too much to send at once. Shorten it and try again.
reason.auth_busy: Sign-in is busy right now. Try again in a moment.
reason.auth_failed: Sign-in isn't working right now. Try again in a moment.
reason.mail_delivery_failed: KatWork couldn't send the email. Ask your admin to check the mail settings.
reason.host_not_allowed: This KatWork server doesn't answer at this address. Open KatWork from its usual address.
reason.cross_site_request: This request came from another site, so KatWork blocked it. Open KatWork directly and try again.
reason.json_required: KatWork couldn't read that request. Reload the page and try again.
reason.database_unavailable: KatWork can't reach its database right now. Try again in a moment.
reason.database_error: Something went wrong while saving. Try again.
reason.not_found: That page or item doesn't exist.
reason.network_error: Can't reach KatWork. Check your connection and try again.
